title: Important Security Notice Regarding Fake SMS Scam Targeting Bahrain Users
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Recently, we received reports of users receiving fake SMS messages from scammers. We’ve observed that users in Bahrain are being particularly targeted.  Please be aware that Binance will  never  contact users via phone calls, and we do not operate any call centers. SMS messaging is used exclusively for sending OTP codes and are not accompanied by a call center number. The only trusted sources are the official Binance.com website and App. Examples of Scam SMS: The SMS you received claims that a withdrawal has been “whitelisted”. The message tells you to call an unknown phone number. Messages may appear in the same thread as official Binance 2FA messages, urging you to click a link to upgrade or verify your account. How to Protect Your Binance Account: Ignore and delete  any suspicious SMS messages and do not engage.  Do not call the number in these messages.  They may connect to a fake call center pretending to be Binance. Do not share any personal information with anyone , especially your One-Time Passwords (OTPs). Use  Binance Verify  to confirm whether an URL, email, phone number, or account is legitimate.  Report  to   contact  Binance Support  through the official in-app or website chat. More Information: What Is SMS Spoofing and How to Avoid Secure Your Binance Account in 7 Simple Steps Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-12
